subject.title: fix(runtime): classify failures and bound watch shutdown

question: Is a universal 250 ms grace period acceptable for every watch iterator return and provider cleanup implementation?
rationale: The diff deliberately trades complete cleanup time for bounded shutdown, and unit coverage cannot establish whether all real provider implementations can settle within that contract.

options.title: Require representative shutdown proof
options.body: Run the exact head against representative provider cleanup paths and adjust the grace period if legitimate cleanup exceeds 250 ms.

options.title: Accept the strict deadline
options.body: Treat 250 ms as the new shutdown contract and accept that slower provider cleanup will surface a timeout during termination.

recommendation.title: Require representative shutdown proof
recommendation.body: Run the exact head against representative provider cleanup paths and adjust the grace period if legitimate cleanup exceeds 250 ms.

likelyOwner.reason: This repository member authored both runtime commits and is the only explicitly identified person connected to the new deadline contract in the supplied history.
